products.name: X1 Skin
products.description: A flexible e-skin that conforms to body contours, capturing pressure, stretch, and posture changes as real-time input for haptic feedback.

products.name: X1 Haptic Vest
products.alt: X1 modular haptic vest system concept
products.description: A B2B modular haptic vest for XR, location-based immersive experiences, and training, designed for maintainability, washability, and reliable deployment.

products.name: X1 Studio
products.alt: X1 Studio haptic authoring and training platform concept
products.description: An authoring platform connecting content events, sensing input, and spatial haptic feedback, with support for development, deployment, device management, and data logging.

scenes.name: XR Content & Immersive Experiences
scenes.description: Turn collision direction, blast impact, and spatial events into body feedback, helping content teams deepen immersion without building their own hardware.
values: Shorter SDK integration and content-adaptation cycles
Prebuilt spatial haptic templates and audio-to-haptics
Developer kits, volume hardware, and software licensing
scenes.delivery: Haptic vest + SDK + game-event interface + haptic templates

scenes.name: Sports & Movement Training
scenes.description: Use motion capture and directional haptic cues to help coaches and researchers analyze movement deviation and create repeatable training feedback.
values: For sports schools, clubs, and training institutions
Validated through correction outcomes and wearing comfort
scenes.delivery: Sensing modules + movement cues + training analytics

scenes.name: Rehabilitation Research
scenes.description: Currently positioned as a research tool and ethics-study platform for exploring the value of haptic cues in movement training. It makes no diagnostic or therapeutic claims.
values: Open raw data and synchronized timestamps
Medical uses require separate classification, clinical, and registration pathways
scenes.delivery: Research kit + data interface + joint research support

scenes.name: Industrial & Safety Training
scenes.description: Provide cues for hazard direction, collision location, and movement deviation in low-risk simulations, while recording training sessions for review.
values: For firefighting, industrial safety, and vocational training
Validated through system stability, training outcomes, and data security
scenes.delivery: Industry hardware + private platform + custom interfaces + maintenance

scenes.name: Research, Education & HCI
scenes.description: Provide university labs and interaction-research teams with an open API, replaceable modules, and observable data to lower the barrier to further development.
values: Haptic blind tests and teaching demonstrations for 10-50 people
Joint projects across materials, perception, and algorithms
scenes.delivery: Developer kit + API documentation + sample projects + technical support
